name: 局域网文件传输
description: Transfer files, images and text between any device's browser over LAN or hotspot. Scan the QR code to connect, no app install required.

localizedDescriptions.zh: 在局域网或热点下与任意设备的浏览器互传文件、图片和文字，扫码即连，无需安装应用。
localizedDescriptions.en: Transfer files, images and text between any device's browser over LAN or hotspot. Scan the QR code to connect, no app install required.
